name: What kind of maintenance does a gas line for a range require?

mainEntity.name: What kind of maintenance does a gas line for a range require?

acceptedAnswer.text: Gas lines generally require minimal ongoing maintenance, but periodic professional inspections are important for safety and longevity. A qualified plumber can check for leaks, assess the condition of the line, and ensure all connections are secure. It is crucial to never attempt to repair or modify a gas line yourself. If you ever smell gas, immediately evacuate the area and contact your gas provider and a professional plumber.
acceptedAnswer.description: Gas lines need minimal maintenance, but periodic professional inspections are crucial to check for leaks and ensure secure connections.
